answer: In our network, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing prevents Sybil attacks via topological cut verifications. Clustered peer graphs must pass independent cross-cluster audits; any detected collusion triggers immediate stake slashing. Like weeding a tainted orchard, auditing isolates forged identities and burns their bonded capital. Every forged identity costs an exponential stake scaling with cut size, making mass generation unaffordable while safeguarding every valid relic and pearl of consensus truth.
